description: This file implements a React component named LessonsManagement, which provides a front-end interface for managing lessons within an admin panel. It includes features for listing lessons, creating new ones, editing titles via quick edit, and deleting lessons. The component interacts with an API client and utilizes user authentication context.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of lessons from the API and updates the component state, handling loading and error states.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new lesson by calling the API and then reloading the lessons list.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a lesson by ID after user confirmation, updating the local state.

methods.name: onQuickEdit
methods.description: Allows quick editing of a lesson's title via prompt, updating the lesson through the API.
